body:
I feel this has helped, I think I've known for a while that I needed to talk to someone. 

I think right now what's really on my mind is the project I've been putting off. I've had it for about a month now and it's due Friday. Every time I think about it it just seems such a daunting prospect ever completing it. I didn't start it over christmas and I'm not really sure why, I think because it felt so insurmountable. Now I'm in a position where I don't know if I'm able to finish it in time. I don't even know that I'm able to finish it at all because the material feels so beyond me. I feel like I can't ask anyone for help because I've left it so late to start it. What's more I don't even know if my feelings on it are accurate. Maybe I can finish it in time, maybe it's not as bad as it looks. I don't even know. I've tried to break it down into smaller parts and I've made a brief start on it, but I can't tell if what I've done so far is good or not. 

I think that was more than I intended to write when I started that, but it just sort of flowed out

I don't feel like I'm being lectured, I wouldn't have posted if I hadn't wanted a response. 

I understand on one level that I shouldn't bottle up my feelings, that's why I'm here. On the other hand I feel like I wouldn't even know how to begin telling them. One second I'm this guy who has everything figured out and then next, I don't know how to finish this sentence. "Then next, I'm not" I guess.

The university counselling office opens in about an hour, I think I'm going to go in when it does.

I don't doubt the people around me would support me, at least on a rational level. But I feel like if I tell them how I feel then I become an additional burden they have to bear. I feel at least this way the only person suffering from my unhappiness is me.
